gloss: irregular working hours; non-standard work schedule

definitions.gloss: irregular working hours; non-standard work schedule
definitions.explanation: a work schedule that deviates from the standard daytime hours, including shift work, rotating schedules, and split shifts

examples.japanese: {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}は{体|からだ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかる。
examples.english: Irregular working hours put a strain on the body.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}は{変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}が{多|おお}い{職業|しょくぎょう}だ。
examples.english: Nursing is a profession with many irregular shifts.

examples.japanese: {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}のせいで{生活|せいかつ}リズムが{崩|くず}れて、{睡眠|すいみん}の{質|しつ}が{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: Because of irregular working hours, my daily rhythm was disrupted and my sleep quality declined.

notes:
Combines {変則|へんそく} (irregular, non-standard) and {勤務|きんむ} (work, duty). Common in healthcare, manufacturing, transportation, and service industries where 24-hour operations require employees to work outside regular business hours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}{手当|てあて}: irregular hours allowance
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}{体制|たいせい}: irregular shift system
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}に{慣|な}れる: to get used to irregular hours
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}を{強|し}いられる: to be forced into irregular hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交代勤務|こうたいきんむ}: shift work — working in rotating shifts with other workers
- {夜勤|やきん}: night shift — specifically working during nighttime hours
- {不規則勤務|ふきそくきんむ}: irregular work — similar meaning with slightly different nuance
- フレックスタイム: flextime — flexible hours chosen by the worker, a positive arrangement
